{
  "summary": "Add git to repair job dependencies to fix missing git command in ci-repair.sh",
  "patch": "diff --git a/.gitlab-ci.yml b/.gitlab-ci.yml
index ced736ab..f0e1d2c3 100644
--- a/.gitlab-ci.yml
+++ b/.gitlab-ci.yml
@@ -64,7 +64,7 @@ repair:
     - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME =~ /^renovate\//'
       when: on_failure
     - when: never
   script:
-    - nix-env -iA nixpkgs.curl nixpkgs.jq nixpkgs.gnused >/dev/null
+    - nix-env -iA nixpkgs.curl nixpkgs.jq nixpkgs.gnused nixpkgs.git >/dev/null
     - bash scripts/ci-repair.sh
   artifacts:
     when: always
",
  "comment": "The repair job failed because `git` was not installed after the script's dependency installation was moved to `.gitlab-ci.yml`. This patch adds `nixpkgs.git` to the `nix-env` command. The `build:desktop` failure appears unrelated and likely stems from the flake.lock update; further investigation is needed.",
  "confidence": "medium"
}
